paragraphs.text: Plant is a creature type used for cards that depict organisms that produce their food from inorganic matter by the process of photosynthesis and that have more or less rigid cell walls containing cellulose. This definition includes mosses but excludes fungi . Sapient trees are classified as Treefolk .

The Plant subtype was introduced relatively late. The first creature to bear the type was Utopia Tree in Invasion though the Carnivorous Plant from The Dark and Singing Tree from Arabian Nights were later issued errata to become plants as well.

In the Grand Creature Type Update , a lot of cards gained the additional Plant type. Note that while Wall of Brambles is now a Plant Wall, Wall of Wood is just a Wall . "Wood" is no longer alive, so it's no longer a Plant.

Many predatory plants attract food by producing smells redolent of food, from the smell of sweet nectar to the odor of decaying meat. They then close jaw-like leaves around their prey or capture them in sticky pools of digestive juice. A few plants are more active. They lunge up from the forest canopy to grab flying dinosaurs in woody claws or tangle them in vines, or they pull up their roots and creep across the forest floor in search of good hunting grounds.

All treefolk from Lorwyn begin life as a "seedbody" or 'seedcone", but not all seedbodies become fully animated and sapient. Most become trees, albeit relatively intelligent trees with the potential to become aware and mobile.

On Theros , the god Nylea honors those that she deems worthy by transforming them into trees, thereby blessing them with long lives. These Carayatids and their descendants protect Setessa and share their wisdom. Other caryatids can be found in Ilysia in the Underworld .

Cactusfolk ( 20 cards ) are the only known sapient species indigenous to Thunder Junction . Having only awoken to sapience after the plane connected to the Omenpaths in 4562 AR , they are a young culture. With few alternative food sources, the plane's vampires occasionally unsuccessfully attempt to feed on cactusfolk.
Svogthos, the Restless Tomb is a creatureland that can become a */* black and green Plant Zombie .
Restless Vinestalk can become a 5/5 blue-green Plant with trample .
Cactus Preserve can become an X/X mono-green Plant with reach .
